config.move-while-attacking.name: Melee attacks
config.move-while-attacking.tooltip: Allow moving during a normal (left-click) melee weapon attack.
config.move-while-special.name: Weapon specials
config.move-while-special.tooltip: Allow moving during a melee weapon special move (right-click): sword block, dagger flurry and club smash.
config.move-while-slingshot.name: Slingshot
config.move-while-slingshot.tooltip: Allow moving while pulling back a slingshot.
config.move-speed.name: Speed while attacking
config.move-speed.tooltip: Movement speed while attacking, relative to your normal speed.
config.moving-hop.name: Hop while moving
config.moving-hop.tooltip: Show the vanilla little hop animation when moving while attacking.
config.special-cancels-attack.name: Special cancels attack
config.special-cancels-attack.tooltip: Right-click during a normal attack to cancel it and use the weapon special immediately (if it's off cooldown).
config.attack-cancels-special.name: Attack cancels special
config.attack-cancels-special.tooltip: Left-click during a weapon special to cancel it and attack immediately.
config.hold-attack.name: Hold to attack
config.hold-attack.tooltip: Keep attacking while the attack button (left click) is held.
config.hold-special.name: Hold to use special
config.hold-special.tooltip: Keep using the weapon special whenever it's off cooldown while the special button (right click) is held.
